Name: Exisled
Overview:
Exisled is a twin-stick shooter. The player controls a helicopter which needs to destroy the HQ of The Smog in each of the eight levels. The available actions are the fire cannon (which can either be shot straight ahead by pressing a button or in an angle in the usual twin-stick fashion), bombs which are more suited to take down buildings and the afterburner for quick movement. Collecting power-ups increase weapon power.

The map can be freely explored (of course with enemy resistance) in order to find the enemy HQ buildings. After all are destroyed, the mission is won. However, there are two other building types which probably should be taken care of: radar stations (extend enemy range) and shield generators (protect enemy buildings). Being shot at decreases the helicopter's health bar, but it can be refilled (along with bombs) at the own HQ. The location of enemy and friendly HQ buildings are shown on the HUD.
